Name: Missy's Walls and Floors for Alternative Textures
Author: SimplyMary
Description:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/2683677]MissyDiabolical's walls and floors[/url] converted to an [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] pack with their permission.

Obv you need Alternative Textures for it to work.
This is my first time ever converting textures or even making a mod so let me know if something doesn't work and I'll try to fix it, but it should be good to go.

Credit for the Walls and Floors goes to Missy, all I did was make it work with Alternative Textures
